summary: Expose Node's mutable process.argv array with Node launch layout and stable object identity.

target.notes: Return the shared JS-array-compatible argv object, not a fresh C# array on every read.

semantics.layout: argv[0] is execPath; argv[1] is absolute entry-point path when one was supplied; remaining elements are user arguments
semantics.identity: repeated reads observe the same mutable array object

caveats: Host .NET args normally omit the Node executable and script entry path, so Environment.GetCommandLineArgs is not a drop-in contract.

tests.name: edge identity and mutation
tests.expected_behavior: prints __x because reads share the mutable argv array
